mapper.select: SELECT ls.*, lc.id as cat_id, lc.name as cat_name, lc.description as cat_description, lc.icon as cat_icon FROM learning_subcategories ls LEFT JOIN learning_categories lc ON ls.category_id = lc.id WHERE ls.id = #{id}

SELECT ls.*, lc.id as cat_id, lc.name as cat_name, lc.description as cat_description, lc.icon as cat_icon FROM learning_subcategories ls LEFT JOIN learning_categories lc ON ls.category_id = lc.id ORDER BY ls.sort_order ASC

SELECT ls.*, lc.id as cat_id, lc.name as cat_name, lc.description as cat_description, lc.icon as cat_icon FROM learning_subcategories ls LEFT JOIN learning_categories lc ON ls.category_id = lc.id WHERE ls.category_id = #{categoryId} ORDER BY ls.sort_order ASC

SELECT ls.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM learning_paths lp WHERE lp.subcategory_id = ls.id AND lp.status = 'PUBLISHED') as path_count FROM learning_subcategories ls WHERE ls.category_id = #{categoryId} AND ls.status = 1 ORDER BY ls.sort_order ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO learning_subcategories (category_id, name, description, icon, cover_image, sort_order, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{categoryId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{icon}, #{coverImage}, #{sortOrder}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE learning_subcategories SET category_id = #{categoryId}, name = #{name}, description = #{description}, icon = #{icon}, cover_image = #{coverImage}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, status = #{status}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
